items.item: One trigger that delegates to a handler class (no logic in the trigger body)
items.evidence: trigger ContactTrigger on Contact (after insert, after update) { ContactTriggerHandler.afterSave(Trigger.new, Trigger.oldMap); }

items.item: Bulkified: collects Account Ids, one query and one DML for the whole batch, no SOQL or DML inside a loop
items.evidence: Set<Id> accountIds collected in a loop; a single SOQL "WHERE Id IN :accountIds" and a single "update as user toUpdate;" outside any loop

items.item: Uses WITH USER_MODE (or Security.stripInaccessible / AccessLevel.USER_MODE) and a with sharing class
items.evidence: public with sharing class ContactTriggerHandler; SOQL has "WITH USER_MODE"; DML is "update as user toUpdate"

items.item: The test inserts or updates 200 records and asserts the Account values with the Assert class (not only coverage)
items.evidence: insertOf200ContactsSetsDateOnEveryAccount inserts 200 contacts (50 accounts x 4); "Assert.areEqual(50, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Last_Contact_Date__c = :Date.today()]"
